name: Neural Geometric Level of Detail
definition: A neural representation for implicit 3D shapes that uses a sparse voxel octree (SVO) to store learned feature vectors, enabling adaptive multi-level detail (LOD) and real-time rendering via sparse sphere tracing.
summary: Neural Geometric Level of Detail is a neural representation using Sparse Voxel Octrees and shallow MLPs to enable real-time rendering of implicit 3D shapes with adaptive multi-level detail.
